description: This file defines a Drupal plugin class 'ResponseStatus' that provides a condition based on HTTP response status codes, used within Drupal's conditional logic system.

classes.name: ResponseStatus
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class that implements a condition based on HTTP response status codes, allowing blocks or features to be shown or hidden depending on the response status.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the plugin with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: setRequestStack
methods.description: Sets the RequestStack object for retrieving current HTTP request information.

methods.name: isNegated
methods.description: Indicates whether the condition is negated; returns false.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Provides default configuration for the condition, including default status codes.

methods.name: buildConfigurationForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for selecting response status codes.

methods.name: submitConfigurationForm
methods.description: Handles submission of the configuration form, saving selected status codes.

methods.name: summary
methods.description: Returns a human-readable summary of the condition based on configured status codes.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates whether the current response status matches the configured status codes.

methods.name: getCacheContexts
methods.description: Returns cache contexts relevant to this condition, including URL path.
